caseName: Burnley v. Railway Labor Executives' Ass'n
caseNameFull: Burnley, Secretary of Transportation v. Railway Labor Executives' Assn.

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of Thomas Colley et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 86-1879, National Treasury Employees Union et al. v. Von Raab, Commissioner, United States Customs Service [certiorari granted, 485 U. S. 903].
